title: ClassificationResult
description: The vision worker never returns a boolean. It returns one of three statuses: safe (publish the photo), unsafe (reject it) or unavailable (leave it pending, ask a human). category is one of the five frozen categories from docs/contracts/enums.md, or 'unknown' which is a worker-only value that is never stored.

status.description: safe -> photo_state approved; unsafe -> rejected; unavailable -> stays pending_check. unavailable is never treated as safe.

category.description: One of the five frozen categories, or 'unknown' (worker-only, never stored).
